gaps.answer: the reason she was chosen / the reason why she was chosen
accept: the reason why she was chosen
gaps.lead: They chose her for the lead role because of her voice.
gaps.sentence: Her voice was ___ for the lead role.
gaps.explanation: the reason (why/that) + clause: the reason (why) she was chosen.

gaps.lead: Everybody says he is the best dentist in town.
gaps.sentence: He ___ the best dentist in town.
gaps.explanation: be supposed to be = generally believed to be.

gaps.lead: The doctor advised a complete rest.
gaps.explanation: advise + object + to-infinitive: advised him to take.

gaps.lead: There's no milk left in the fridge.
gaps.explanation: run out of = have none left.

gaps.lead: They say this forest is three hundred years old.
gaps.sentence: This forest ___ three hundred years old.
gaps.explanation: be supposed to be = generally said/believed to be.
